name: Glaciologist

intro.text: I study ice for a living, and ice has taught me one thing. Everything moves, slowly. Except me. I'm not moving till you've beaten me.

win: Fine. Take the stamp. I've been standing here for a month, and I've enjoyed every second.
after: Ice flows. It takes hundreds of years to get from here to the sea. In the meantime, I'm making the tea.
